name: astrology_system
description: Complete natal astrology system with Swiss Ephemeris, chart calculations, comparisons, and Telegram interface
author: katuarel

added: Complete PostgreSQL schema (astro_charts, astro_placements, astro_house_cusps, astro_aspects, astro_chart_comparisons, astro_comparison_aspects)
Enhanced chart calculator with batch processing
Group analysis queries (find all Mars in Aries, etc.)
Helper views and functions for quick queries
database: Created 6 new tables for astrology data

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS astro_comparison_aspects, astro_chart_comparisons, astro_aspects, astro_house_cusps, astro_placements, astro_charts CASCADE;

notes: First natal chart system in Mythos
Swiss Ephemeris files downloaded during installation
Birth data already exists for Ka'tuar'el, Seraphe, and Fitz in people table
Charts automatically calculated for all people with birth data on install
Support for multiple house systems (Placidus, Whole Sign, Equal, Koch, etc.)
Ready for bi-wheel comparisons and synastry analysis
Future: SVG chart rendering, transits, progressions, composite charts
